DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL & COMPUTER SYSTEMS
FAKE STANFORD AFFILIATE COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Aditya Verma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2021-2023) at Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology.

During this tenure, Aditya Verma demonstrated exceptional mastery in Natural Language Processing, Transformers, FastAPI, PostgreSQL. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Distributed Consensus in Fault-Tolerant Blockchain Networks', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Aditya Verma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Aditya Verma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. K. V. Ramanathan
Dean of Academic Research
Electrical & Computer Systems
Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology
Email: .k..v..ramanathan@fakestanfo.edu
